Film (FILM)

[1] Courses in Film (FILM)

FILM 2310 Introduction to Film Studies 3 Credits. A survey of the history and language of narrative film, from the silent era to the present. Screenings outside class are required.

FILM 2666 Film Production I 3 Credits. Camera, sound, and editing for short narrative work. Prerequisites: FILM 2310 and 45 total credit hours completed.

FILM 4V70 Advanced Film Production 3 Credits. Individual projects in narrative story construction. Production. Prerequisites: FILM 2310 and 2666 and 45 total credit hours completed.
